items.title: Logical connectives: AND, OR, NOT (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Logical connectives with Figure 2.4 and a small Python program of ours (PDF 28, printed 24).

blocks.text: Logical connectives woh lafz hain jo propositions ko jorte hain. AND tab istemal hota hai jab dono statements ka sach hona zaroori ho. OR tab jab kam az kam ek statement sach ho. NOT kisi statement ki sachai ulat deta hai (sach ko jhoot, jhoot ko sach). Yeh connectives compound propositions banane mein madad dete hain aur computer programs mein aam istemal hote hain. Logical connectives faisla karne mein madad dete hain (Figure 2.4 dekhein). Yeh logical expressions ko saaf banate hain, is liye inhein samajhna zaroori hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein. AND: daire A aur B, teer par A and B, 'dono A aur B sach hon to sach', aur Venn diagram jis mein sirf mushtarka hissa rangeen hai. OR: daire A aur B, teer par A or B, 'A ya B (ya dono) sach hon to sach', aur dono daire rangeen. NOT: daira A, teer par Not A, 'A jhoot ho to sach', aur A par kati lakeer.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4: Mantiqi connectives AND, OR, NOT (kitab ki Figure 2.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har line mein baayen taraf inputs A aur B hain aur daayen taraf nateeja. Venn diagram mein rang wala (hatched) hissa woh hai jahan nateeja sach hai: AND mein sirf A aur B ka mushtarka (common) hissa, OR mein dono daire poore. NOT ke liye kitab daire A par kati hui lakeer dikhati hai, yani NOT A tab sach hai jab A jhoot ho.
Python mein bhi yahi teen connectives hain: and, or, not. Neeche A aur B ki values True ya False kar ke Run karein aur dekhein ke nateeja kaise badalta hai.

A = True     # pehla proposition
B = False    # doosra proposition

print("A =", A, " B =", B)
print("A AND B =", A and B)
print("A OR B  =", A or B)
print("NOT A   =", not A)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"A = True" aur "B = False": do propositions ki values. Python mein sach ko True aur jhoot ko False likhte hain (pehla harf bara).
print("A AND B =", A and B): "and" tab True deta hai jab dono True hon. Yahan B False hai, is liye False.
print("A OR B  =", A or B): "or" tab True deta hai jab kam az kam ek True ho. A True hai, is liye True.
print("NOT A   =", not A): "not" value ulat deta hai: True ka False.
Output: chaar lines: "A = True  B = False", "A AND B = False", "A OR B  = True" aur "NOT A   = False".
Khud try karein: B = True kar ke Run karein: A AND B = True ho jayega. Phir A = False, B = False kar ke dekhein: OR bhi False aur NOT A True ho jayega.

items: AND: dono sach hon; OR: kam az kam ek sach ho; NOT: value ulat do.
